title: Project Sidekick directed-energy weapon
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Project Sidekick directed-energy weapon, about 1980s at S4 / Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but then there's also project sidekick which is a weapon.

plain: Bob Lazar, who says he worked in the 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert where he says alien craft were studied, says that besides the craft work there was a separate effort called Project Sidekick. He says Sidekick was a weapon, one that fires focused energy, which if true would mean the site was also building arms from what it learned.
